about_the_game:
HELL ON WHEELS

Fright Train is a third-person action survival horror game in which you'll explore the monster-ridden corridors of an enormous train speeding through Antarctica. Keep it running by maintaining its parts, because if the train stops, there’s no telling what abomination might emerge from the blizzard to claim you...

STORY MODE

You play as a paranormal special agent responding to an anonymous distress signal from the L.R.S. Great White: a seemingly deserted locomotive research station owned by the ominous SHARK corporation.

You'll need courage and smarts to fight back against the monsters unleashed by SHARK's sinister schemes and solve the puzzles standing in your way. Prepare to meet allies and encounter foes as you navigate the train's iron bowels. Monitor its condition and keep it running to avoid freezing to death and being swarmed by monsters. Will you be able to find the source of these horrors and put an end to them?

SURVIVAL MODE

Test your skills and develop clever strategies to stay alive as long as possible in Fright Train's Survival Mode!

Scavenge the procedurally generated train for resources and unlock new cars and rooms by using the credits you gather, but don't forget to take time to prepare yourself for the waves of enemies that will appear during deadly storms. Compete for the top place on the leaderboards, and who knows? There might be more than one train on these tracks…

KEY FEATURES

  • Meaningful and tactical inventory management. Big and medium-sized items are physically displayed on the character, and the speed at which he can fetch them depends on where the item is located on the body: a magazine will be quicker to insert if it's stored on the chest rather than on the lower back!

  • A volatile combat ecosystem in which enemy behaviors intertwine, allowing them to support or sabotage one another. Some enemies have armor and weak points: learn how to exploit their vulnerabilities and responses to attacks!

  • A lived-in environment in which you'll find lore and many objects with which you can interact: vending machines for supplies, crates to kick, terminals to monitor and repair the train's parts, doors to unlock, and more!

  • Semi-realistic stylized graphics and characters driven by a B-movie style story.

  • A chilling and exciting adaptive soundtrack!

content_descriptors.notes: Depiction of cartoon character corpses; dismemberment of monsters; blood; horror themes.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 980
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: None

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • VR Support: None

short_description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.
